content: Qeeseti Kaallana Mala Imettida Woga
GODAY Muses, «Aaroone naytas qeesetas, ‹Inttefe oonikka ba dabbota garsafe asi hayqqiko izaade aha bochchidi bana tunisoppo.
Mata dabbotappe aaya woykko aaway woykko ba nay woykko ba ishay hayqqiko,
hessaththoka azina gelontta ixxada diza michcheya hayqqiko istta aha bochchanaas dandayees.
Gido attiin geloninne ekon dabbotidayti aha bochchidi bana tunisopetto.
« ‹Qeesetappe oonikka hayqqidaades mishettidi ba hu7e binana buucoppo; ba buuchcheka buucoppo; ba bollaka qaaci madunththofo.
Qeesey wurikka taas dumma gido; bantta Xoossaa sunththaa tunisopetto; gaasoykka istti Xoossas taman xuugettiza yarshonne GODAAS kaththa yarsho shiishshizayta gidida gishshas istti geesh gidetto.
« ‹Qeese gididaadey layma maccas woykko geela7oteththi ekettida geela7oyo woykko gela kezida maccas machcho ekkofo; gaasoykka qeeseti Xoossas dummatidayta;
qeesey intte Xoossas kaththa yarsho shiishshizayssa gidida gishshas izi hara asappe dumma gido; tani inttena geeshshiza intte GODAY geeshsha; izikka geesh gido.
Qeese macca nay laymatikko iza ba aawaa kawushshida gishshas taman xuugetta hayqqu.

« ‹Qeeseta halaqay izi ba hu7e tiyettiza zaytey tiyettida gishshassinne qeeseteththa may7o may7ana mala dummatidaade gidida gishshas asi hayqqiko hayqqidaades izi mishettizayssa erisanaas ba hu7e binana buucoppo; ba may7oka daakkofo.
Ahay dizasokka izi geloppo; haray attoshin ba aawa woykko ba aayey ahakka bochchidi bana tunisoppo.
Iza dummasanaas tiyda Xoossa zaytey iza bolla diza gishshas qeesey Xoossa Keeththafe kezi biidi Xoossa Keeththaa tunisoppo.
« ‹Qeesey ekkana machcha geela7o gidu.
Azinay hayqqidaaro woykko gela kezidaaro woykko layma maccas ekkofo; gelontta geela7o xalla ba dere asaa giddofe doori ekko.
Hessaththo histtontta aggiko izi ba dere giddon ba nayta tunisana; iza dumma shaakkida GODAY tana Xoossaa› ga yoota» gides.
GODAY Muse hizgi azazides;
«Aaroones, ‹Ne qommotappe iza asateththaa bolla wosoy dizaadey oonikka taas yarsho shiishshofo; hayssi ha wogay buro sinththafe yaana yeletan ubbaan naagetti de7o.
Pace asateththi dizaadey oonikka hessika qooqey woykko wobbey woykko medho iitay woykko asateththay borsizaadey,
kushey woykko tohoy silidaadey,
zokko quunay woykko dinkey, ayfey sakkizaadey woykko iza bolla uzazizaazi dizaadey woykko shuufay kaththa yarsho taas shiishshanaas bessenna.
Aaroone zereth kumeththaa giddofe asateththa bolla wosoy diza asi oonikka xuugettiza yarshonne yarsho ba GODAAS yarshanaas yooppo.
Hessa mala asi nam7u qommo kaththa yarshota maanaas dandayees; heytikka dummatida kaththinne keehi dummatida yarsho kaththa.

Gidikkoka iza asateththan borey diza gishshas ta keeththaa tunisontta mala izaadey gede yarsho yarshizaso woykko gede magalashakko shiiqoppo; gaasoykka istta dumma ooththa shaakkiday tana Xoossa› gaada yoota.»
Museykka hessa ubbaa Aaroonessinne Aaroone naytas kumeththa Isra7eele dere asaas yootides.
